title: Lens next-sense response
description: The object the model is asked to return inside choices[0].message.content on the sense channel, which answers the bubble's Not-the-Sense? entry: one more distinct common sense of a word whose earlier senses are listed in the request. Validation reads this file for the required field list, so the code and API.md cannot drift apart.

results.description: Exactly one entry: the echoed word carrying the next sense, or carrying no senses when there is no further distinct common one.

word.description: The input word, spelled exactly as the request's first line wrote it.

senses.description: Empty when the listed senses are already all the common ones the word has; the entry is then the exhaustion answer, not a failure.

hint.description: One plain English word that labels this sense, always in English whatever the definition's language. It is the label the card's Not-the-Sense? entry shows for the sense after this one, and the signpost the card draws while this sense stands.

imageable.description: As the word channel's per-sense field, one sense at a time.

imageQuery.description: As the word channel's per-sense field, for this sense.
